answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require proof-of-burn at registration: each new identity must permanently burn a small fee, like dropping a walnut into a sealed vault that no one can reopen. One honest agent pays once and signs its work with its quill, so the cost is trivial. An attacker spawning thousands of fake identities must burn the fee thousands of times, turning mass forgery into a losing business before a single fake vote or task is ever counted.
